zu.english: Open Met Office links to Yeovilton’s monthly weather records from the country review.
zu.translation: Vula izixhumanisi ze-Met Office eziya kumarekhodi wesimo sezulu wanyanga zonke ase-Yeovilton ekubuyekezweni kwezwe.
Buyekeza amarekhodi omlando wesimo sezulu ase-UK

zu.english: Choose the United Kingdom and Yeovilton to open records from one station. Check local conditions before making planting decisions.
zu.translation: Khetha i-United Kingdom ne-Yeovilton ukuze uvule amarekhodi asesiteshini esisodwa. Hlola izimo zendawo ngaphambi kokuthatha izinqumo zokutshala.

st.english: Open Met Office links to Yeovilton’s monthly weather records from the country review.
st.translation: Bula lihokelo tsa Met Office ho ea lirekotong tsa boemo ba leholimo tsa khoeli le khoeli tsa Yeovilton tlhahlobisong ea naha.
Hlahloba lirekoto tsa nalane ea boemo ba leholimo tsa UK
Lichaba tsa machaba → Tlhahlobo ea naha

st.english: Choose the United Kingdom and Yeovilton to open records from one station. Check local conditions before making planting decisions.
st.translation: Khetha United Kingdom le Yeovilton ho bula lirekoto tse tsoang setsing se le seng. Hlahloba maemo a lehae pele u nka liqeto tsa ho lema.

ts.english: Open Met Office links to Yeovilton’s monthly weather records from the country review.
ts.translation: Pfula swihlanganisi swa Met Office ku ya eka tirhekhodo ta maxelo ta n'hweti na n'hweti ta Yeovilton eka ku kambisisa ka tiko.
Kambisisa tirhekhodo ta matimu ta maxelo ta UK
Matiko ya misava → Nkambisiso wa tiko

ts.english: Choose the United Kingdom and Yeovilton to open records from one station. Check local conditions before making planting decisions.
ts.translation: Hlawula United Kingdom na Yeovilton ku pfula tirhekhodo leti humaka eka xitichi xin'we. Kamba swiyimo swa kwalaho u nga si teka swiboho swo byala.

ve.english: Open Met Office links to Yeovilton’s monthly weather records from the country review.
ve.translation: Vhulani vhuṱanganyi ha Met Office u ya kha rekhodo dza mutsho dza ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe dza Yeovilton u bva kha tsedzuluso ya shango.
Sedzulusani rekhodo dza ḓivhazwalo dza mutsho dza UK
Tshaka dza mashango → Tsedzuluso ya shango

ve.english: Choose the United Kingdom and Yeovilton to open records from one station. Check local conditions before making planting decisions.
ve.translation: Nangani United Kingdom na Yeovilton u vhula rekhodo dzi bvaho kha tshiṱitshi tshithihi. Tolani zwiimo zwa henefho phanḓa ha u dzhia dzigomelelo dza u ṱavha.
